business: IRCTC, a Navratna CPSE under Ministry of Railways, operates digital ticketing, hospitality, tourism, and packaged drinking water services for Indian Railways. Revenue from Internet Ticketing (₹1,536 crore), Catering (₹2,399 crore), Tourism (₹890 crore), and Rail Neer (₹407 crore). Serves millions of passengers annually.

segments.name: Catering
segments.comment: 63+ crore meals annually across 1,450+ trains; 12.88% YoY growth

segments.name: Internet Ticketing
segments.comment: 88.74% of reserved bookings; 14.5 lakh daily; 7.66% growth

segments.name: Tourism
segments.comment: Bharat Gaurav trains, luxury journeys, pilgrimage circuits; 19.49% revenue growth

segments.name: Rail Neer
segments.comment: Packaged drinking water; 20 plants; 20.65% profit growth

revenue_mix: Product-portfolio: Catering (46%), Internet Ticketing (30%), Tourism (17%), Rail Neer (8%). Operations span 1,450+ trains, 420+ railway stations, all-India network.
strategy: Expand digital capabilities and mobile-first ticketing platform adoption
Grow tourism portfolio including Bharat Gaurav trains and circuits
Build integrated travel ecosystem for end-to-end passenger journeys
Deepen engagement through co-branded partnerships and digital services
Advance environmental stewardship and community development initiatives
outlook: India's travel economy expanding with rising domestic tourism. IRCTC positioned to support growth through strengthened digital platforms, expanded tourism offerings, and superior passenger experiences.
capex_plans: Infrastructure enhancements: Next Generation e-Ticketing platform (37,000 tickets/minute capacity), AI-enabled monitoring, solar installations. No forward capex guidance.
